glsa.title: GnuPG: Multiple Vulnerabilities
glsa.synopsis: Multiple vulnerabilities have been discovered in GnuPG, the worst of which could lead to execution of arbitrary code.

background.p: The GNU Privacy Guard, GnuPG, is a free replacement for the PGP suite of cryptographic software.

description.p: Multiple vulnerabilities have been discovered in GnuPG. They are described at https://gpg.fail/.

impact.p: A remote attacker could entice a user or automated system to process a specially crafted signature file, possibly resulting in execution of arbitrary commands with the privileges of the process.

workaround.p:
Avoid using clear signatures, instead use detached signatures (https://gnupg.org/blog/20251226-cleartext-signatures.html).
Always use --output rather than relying on either the default filename GnuPG suggests or output to stdout.
